content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to set up Modbus TCP/IP communication between an [product_name] HMI panel and a [product_name] controller with [version_no]. Should the HMI act as the server or the client?
Hi, You should consult the documentation for your HMI panel. The [product_name] controller with [version_no] offers 8 connections which can be configured as either ModbusTCP client or server.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for straightforward instructions about server and client roles when configuring Modbus TCP/IP between an HMI panel and a controller. The discussion highlights a lack of clarity in existing resources, prompting suggestions to reference the manual, which may not clearly address this common setup question.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want direct and easy-to-follow information on whether to configure their HMI panel and controller as Modbus server or client for TCP/IP communication.
